description: This file implements the core functions for handling HTTP Webc Trans operations such as query mode determination, receiving data, sending requests, finishing transactions, and aborting connections. It contains function implementations related to HTTP transaction state management and data processing within the Http Webc Trans Object.

methods.name: ULONG HttpWctoQuery(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hBufferContext)
methods.description: Determines how to process the incoming payload based on the current message and buffer states, returning a processing mode.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpWctoRecv(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hBufferContext)
methods.description: Processes received payloads by invoking the process method of the response object, and updates the transaction state accordingly.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpWctoSend(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hMessage,ULONG ulSendFlags)
methods.description: Handles sending HTTP request messages including headers and body based on provided flags.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpWctoFinish(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hBufferContext)
methods.description: Finalizes the transaction upon connection closure, freeing resources if the response state indicates completion.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpWctoAbort(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulEvent)
methods.description: Handles aborting the transaction due to network failure by notifying the BSP interface.
